title: Documented Stage A re-run image after the NAT-091 delivery shortfall: NAT-090's payload and loader with only the image name (loader-diag-xnu-sb-md1) and the command-line tag (NAT092-sb1) changed; build, package, derive the session driver, tests incl. byte-for-byte comparison with NAT-090's build, mutation pass, decision draft
acceptance: The built payload equals NAT-090's byte for byte except the command-line tag (NAT090-sa1 -> NAT092-sb1); the loader image differs from NAT-090's only in the words that encode the image name; the md0 region equals NAT-089's Stage A small root (sha256 recorded); the packaged RECOVERY and payload hashes are recorded.

A session driver derived from NAT-087's by counted substitutions (derive92.py --check) with the registry gate NAT-089, NAT-090, NAT-092 (NAT-091 is not required: it ran and was inconclusive), tests, a mutation pass over build.py and derive92.py under the RAM cap, and a decision draft with every hash recomputed that states it is a documented re-run after a delivery shortfall and requires an idle host. Nothing here measures the phone.
